paragraphs.text: 1. Ye by your hymns are like high-thoughted singers, skillful, inviting Gods with sacrifices;
paragraphs.original: विप्रासो न मन्मभिः स्वाध्यो देवाव्यो न यज्ञैः स्वप्नसः ।
paragraphs.translit: viprāso na manmabhiḥ svādhyo devāvyo na yajñaiḥ svapnasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Fair to behold, like Kings, with bright adornment, like spotless gallants, leaders of the people:
paragraphs.original: राजानो न चित्राः सुसंदृशः क्षितीनां न मर्या अरेपसः
paragraphs.translit: rājāno na citrāḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ kṣitīnāṃ na maryā arepasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Like fire with flashing flame, breast-bound with chains of gold, like tempest-blasts, self-moving, swift to lend your aid;
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्न ये भ्राजसा रुक्मवक्षसो वातासो न स्वयुजः सद्यऊतयः ।
paragraphs.translit: agnirna ye bhrājasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: As best of all foreknowers, excellent to guide, like Somas, good to guard the man who follows Law.
paragraphs.original: प्रज्ञातारो न ज्येष्ठाः सुनीतयः सुशर्माणो न सोमा ऋतं यते
paragraphs.translit: prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate

paragraphs.text: 3. Shakers of all, like gales of wind they travel, like tongues of burning fires in their effulgence.
paragraphs.original: वातासो न ये धुनयो जिगत्नवोऽग्नीनां न जिह्वा विरोकिणः ।
paragraphs.translit: vātāso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokiṇaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Mighty are they as warriors clad in armour, and, like the Fathers' prayers, Most Bounteous Givers.
paragraphs.original: वर्मण्वन्तो न योधाः शिमीवन्तः पितॄणां न शंसाः सुरातयः
paragraphs.translit: varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Like spokes of car-wheels in one nave united, ever victorious like heavenly Heroes,
paragraphs.original: रथानां न येऽराः सनाभयो जिगीवांसो न शूरा अभिद्यवः ।
paragraphs.translit: rathānāṃ na ye'rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhidyavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Shedding their precious balm like youthful suitors, they raise their voice and chant their psalm as singers.
paragraphs.original: वरेयवो न मर्या घृतप्रुषोऽभिस्वर्तारो अर्कं न सुष्टुभः
paragraphs.translit: vareyavo na maryā ghṛtapruṣo'bhisvartāro arkaṃ na suṣṭubhaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. They who are fleet to travel like the noblest steeds, long to obtain the prize like bounteous charioteers,
paragraphs.original: अश्वासो न ये ज्येष्ठास आशवो दिधिषवो न रथ्यः सुदानवः ।
paragraphs.translit: aśvāso na ye jyeṣṭhāsa āśavo didhiṣavo na rathyaḥ sudānavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Like waters speeding on with their precipitous floods, like omniform Angirases with Sama-hymns.
paragraphs.original: आपो न निम्नैरुदभिर्जिगत्नवो विश्वरूपा अङ्गिरसो न सामभिः
paragraphs.translit: āpo na nimnairudabhirjigatnavo viśvarūpā aṅgiraso na sāmabhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Born from the stream, like press-stones are the Princes, for ever like the stones that crush in pieces;
paragraphs.original: ग्रावाणो न सूरयः सिन्धुमातर आदर्दिरासो अद्रयो न विश्वहा ।
paragraphs.translit: grāvāṇo na sūrayaḥ sindhumātara ādardirāso adrayo na viśvahā |

paragraphs.text: Sons of a beauteous Dame, like playful children, like a great host upon the march with splendour.
paragraphs.original: शिशूला न क्रीळयः सुमातरो महाग्रामो न यामन्नुत त्विषा
paragraphs.translit: śiśūlā na krīḷayaḥ sumātaro mahāgrāmo na yāmannuta tviṣā

paragraphs.text: 7. Like rays of Dawn, the visitors of sacrifice, they shine with ornaments as eager to be bright.
Like rivers hasting on, glittering with their spears, from far away they measure out the distances.
paragraphs.original: सिन्धवो न ययियो भ्राजदृष्टयः परावतो न योजनानि ममिरे
paragraphs.translit: sindhavo na yayiyo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ parāvato na yojanāni mamire

paragraphs.text: 8. Gods, send us happiness and make us wealthy, letting us singers prosper, O ye Maruts.
Bethink you of our praise and of our friendship: ye from of old have riches to vouchsafe us.
paragraphs.original: अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गात सनाद्धि वो रत्नधेयानि सन्ति
paragraphs.translit: adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāddhi vo ratnadheyāni santi
